name: CargoHub – Kargo Takip Sistemi
author: RomiTeT

sections.description:
CargoHub, WooCommerce mağazaları için tasarlanmıştır. Gönderi bilgilerini yönetmeyi kolaylaştırır ve müşterileri kargo durumu hakkında bilgilendirir.

Key Features
– Custom cargo carriers (add and manage via admin)
– Email notifications to customers when tracking is added
– WooCommerce order integration and My Account display
– Responsive design and accessibility-friendly styles
– Security-conscious implementation (sanitization, escaping, nonces)

This plugin does not require any external services. All processing happens locally in WordPress.

Optionally, a separate PRO offering (distributed outside WordPress.org) provides additional features such as SMS integrations. The free plugin hosted here remains fully functional by itself.

Developer Information

Developed by RomiTeT Creative

  • Website: https://www.romitetcreative.us
  • Support: WordPress.org support forums
  • Documentation: Included in the plugin admin panel

Technical Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.3 or higher
  • MySQL 5.6 or higher

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect personal data. All tracking information is stored locally in your WordPress database.

Support

For support, please use the WordPress.org support forums.
sections.installation:
1. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/cargohub-kargo-takip or install via the Plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active
  4. Open the CargoHub menu in WordPress admin
  5. Add your cargo carriers
  6. Add tracking info to orders
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

How many cargo carriers can I add?

You can add cargo carriers from the admin without any built-in limits.

Does it send SMS?

This free plugin sends email notifications. SMS features are available in a separate PRO offering outside WordPress.org.

Is it compatible with Turkish cargo companies?

Yes. It’s tailored for Turkish e-commerce and supports defining local carriers.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes. It includes responsive styles for common breakpoints.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

Admin experience and notification enhancements:
– Added comprehensive step-by-step “How to Use” onboarding guide and SMTP configuration tips to the admin panel
– Added official WordPress plugin directory link with target blank to email notification footer for improved visibility and user acquisition

1.2.5

Shipment notification refinement:
– Sent the shipment email even when the optional tracking code is empty
– Displayed a dash instead of a fabricated tracking value and hid the tracking link when no code exists
– Removed carrier-specific tracking code format warnings and restrictions

1.2.4

Order synchronization fix:
– Made the tracking code optional while keeping the carrier mandatory for the “Kargoya Verildi” status
– Persisted carrier-only shipment records without sending a tracking email
– Delayed tracking emails until WooCommerce confirms the shipped order status
– Synchronized the saved WooCommerce status with an accepted shipment request

1.2.3

Compatibility hardening:
– Prevented CargoHub from initializing when WooCommerce is unavailable, avoiding frontend fatal errors

1.2.2

Secure logging release:
– Protected plugin logs with non-guessable paths and Apache, IIS and direct PHP access controls
– Added automatic redaction for common credentials and personal tracking data
– Captured fatal PHP errors only when they originate from CargoHub files
– Limited daily logs to 5 MB, total logs to 50 MB and automatically removed logs older than 30 days
– Moved legacy predictable log files into the protected log directory

1.2.1

Stability and data-safety release:
– Prevented site-wide cache flushing during normal requests
– Required CargoHub nonce validation when saving tracking information
– Prevented the “Kargoya Verildi” status when carrier data is unavailable or incomplete
– Preserved orders, carrier definitions and active tracking records during uninstall
– Migrated “Kargoya Verildi” orders to “Tamamlandı” safely when the plugin is deleted
– Removed only obsolete tracking tombstones and temporary plugin data

1.2.0

Major performance, security and compatibility release:
– Added full support for WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) and modern order edit screens
– Optimized database queries to avoid redundant table checks on frontend requests
– Enhanced logger with atomic file write mechanism to prevent memory exhaustion
– Added explicit capability checks for carrier management actions
– Synchronized JavaScript event listeners for live tracking format validation and placeholder styling
– Cleaned up unused helper methods and legacy code

1.1.1

Minor fixes and housekeeping:
– Bump version and stable tag
– Rename main plugin file to cargohub-kargo-takip.php
– Replace visible “FREE” labels with “CargoHub”

1.1.0

Compliance and improvements:
– Removed any limits/locks from the free plugin
– Standardized text domain and slug to cargohub-kargo-takip
– Improved sanitization and escaping in admin flows
– Removed inline CSS from email template head
– Minor UI/UX and performance tweaks

1.0.0

Initial release
– Custom carriers
– Email notifications
– WooCommerce integration
– Admin and My Account interfaces
